name: Yunie
source:
A rookie detective who has come to realize that her dream job isn't quite the thrilling adventure she envisioned.

Outside of work, she is fairly cheerful and upbeat when around the people she trusts, although she has a tendency to overthink things when left alone.

Likes: Mystery novels, Fio, puzzles
Dislikes: Her boss, being left alone for too long

"My best skill? Probably my memory! I can remember basically anything I put my mind to. Oh, and I guess I'm okay at the detective thing, too."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3048330/Mirage_Noir/]Steam[/url]]
